title: Let's build a Chatbot - Speech Input (Part 11)

cues.en: Hi and welcome to part 11 of let's build a chatbot in C-Sharp using Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十一部分。

cues.en: I have a short one for you today which is that we built yet another feature into our
cues.zh: 今天是比較短的內容，再加入一項功能，

cues.en: chatbot and that is that we can speak to the chatbot and then get it transcribed using AI.
cues.zh: 讓使用者可以對聊天機器人說話，再透過 AI 轉成文字。

cues.en: So let's first see it and then take it along.
cues.zh: 先看看效果，再解釋。

cues.en: So what is new since last time is we have this little mic button down here.
cues.zh: 這次新增的是下面的麥克風按鈕。

cues.en: There's tons of ways to do mics and you could essentially do it using the browser itself.
cues.zh: 錄音有很多做法，其實也能直接使用瀏覽器功能。

cues.en: It has speak recognition built in but not every single browser can support it.
cues.zh: 瀏覽器內建語音辨識，但不是每個瀏覽器都支援。

cues.en: So I have chosen to go with having it to be using OpenAI and as OpenAI we also get a little
cues.zh: 因此我選擇 OpenAI。既然是 OpenAI，也能在這裡加入一點，

cues.en: AI in there and not just a bunch of JavaScript.
cues.zh: AI，而不只是 JavaScript。

cues.en: But the way it works is I can just simply press it and it will go into recording mode.
cues.zh: 操作方式是直接按下按鈕，就會進入錄音模式。

cues.en: I can say something and then I can press the stop button in order to just get the text in here.
cues.zh: 說一些話，再按停止，就能把文字放進這裡。

cues.en: We could send the text directly but I've chosen just put it in here so the user can send it or tweak it if a name has been spelled wrong or something like that.
cues.zh: 也可以直接送出，但這裡選擇先放進輸入框，讓使用者能送出，或修正辨識錯誤的姓名等內容。

cues.en: So let's try it out.
cues.zh: 實際試試。

cues.en: What is the weather like in Paris right now?
cues.zh: 巴黎目前的天氣如何？

cues.en: We can see it did that and we can try to send it but that will just work exactly as if I
cues.zh: 可以看到成功了。送出之後，效果完全等同於，

cues.en: put it in manually here.
cues.zh: 手動在這裡輸入。

cues.en: So that works.
cues.zh: 因此能正常運作。

cues.en: I'm going to try in a different language, in this case Danish, but I'm essentially going to say in what country is Paris.
cues.zh: 再試另一種語言，這裡是丹麥文，內容大致是「巴黎在哪個國家？」。

cues.en: I will get l'air Paris.
cues.zh: 巴黎在哪個國家？

cues.en: And in this case I chose it in Danish so you can see it's multi-language by default because it's AI that would be much more difficult if you did it in a browser.
cues.zh: 這次以丹麥文辨識，可以看到預設就支援多語言，因為是 AI；若用瀏覽器內建機制，會比較麻煩。

cues.en: So let's see how this is done.
cues.zh: 接著看看實作。

cues.en: So in the code I have the changes here that are needed.
cues.zh: 程式碼中，這些是需要的變更。

cues.en: And in order for us to get that extra button we simply need a button of course.
cues.zh: 要加入額外按鈕，當然先需要一個按鈕。

cues.en: It has a little bit of CSS, we don't need to go into that.
cues.zh: 有一些 CSS，不用深入介紹。

cues.en: Then we have a button of type button that's disabled while we transcribe.
cues.zh: 這是一個 type 為 button 的按鈕，轉錄時會停用。

cues.en: And we have a toggle recording which you will see in one bit.
cues.zh: 並呼叫稍後會看到的 ToggleRecording。

cues.en: And then the text of it will be if we're transcribing it says dot, dot, dot in order to show please wait.
cues.zh: 按鈕文字在轉錄時顯示三個點，表示請稍候。

cues.en: If we are recording it will say stop because we are in the middle of recording or else it will just say mic.
cues.zh: 錄音時顯示停止，其他時間則顯示麥克風。

cues.en: In terms of backend we need to use JavaScript in order to do this because yes we can send
cues.zh: 至於處理邏輯，需要 JavaScript。因為雖然可以送到，

cues.en: it to a backend and transcribe but there's still something that needs to record the raw audio and that is JavaScript since we are in a browser.
cues.zh: 後端轉錄，但總要先錄製原始聲音，而在瀏覽器中就是透過 JavaScript。

cues.en: So we have pyjs runtime like we normally do in Blazor and we are keeping track of what we're doing right now.
cues.zh: 因此像一般 Blazor 一樣使用 IJSRuntime，也記錄目前狀態。

cues.en: So if we are recording and if we are transcribing.
cues.zh: 例如是否正在錄音、是否正在轉錄。

cues.en: We then need to use something called an audio recorder module which is some JavaScript.
cues.zh: 接著使用 Audio Recorder Module，也就是一段 JavaScript。

cues.en: The JavaScript in general we don't really go into it.
cues.zh: 不會詳細介紹 JavaScript 內容。

cues.en: I have made, ChatGPT made it for me or Codex.
cues.zh: 這是請 ChatGPT 或 Codex 替我撰寫的。

cues.en: So I don't know JavaScript but this could probably also be found on Google.
cues.zh: 我不熟 JavaScript，但類似內容應該也能在網路上找到。

cues.en: Essentially we just get some start recordings and stop recordings here in the system in
cues.zh: 基本上只需要開始錄音與停止錄音的方法，

cues.en: order to get an mp4 file back in a raw stream.
cues.zh: 最後取得 MP4 格式的原始串流。

cues.en: But when we do this we end up with that we toggle here.
cues.zh: 按下按鈕時，會在這裡切換狀態。

cues.en: So we get this module using JavaScript so we import it and if we're not recording we
cues.zh: 先透過 JavaScript 匯入模組，如果目前沒有錄音，

cues.en: just call it with invoke void start recording meaning the recording begins and we tell our
cues.zh: 就呼叫 InvokeVoid 的 StartRecording，開始錄製，並告訴，

cues.en: little indicator if we should switch the title of the button.
cues.zh: 介面指示器切換按鈕文字。

cues.en: When we press the button again we go in and say now we're in transcribe mode.
cues.zh: 再次按下時，就進入轉錄模式。

cues.en: We get the recording by stopping it and then getting our recording here.
cues.zh: 停止錄音，並取得剛剛的錄音。

cues.en: So we're just using the JavaScript in order to get an object which is in the end gives us a stream.
cues.zh: 因此透過 JavaScript 取得物件，最後轉成串流。

cues.en: So now we are in the same place as if we were in a console app or a Windows app.
cues.zh: 現在就和主控台或 Windows 應用程式的處理位置相同了。

cues.en: What we do is we take our agent factory, get our connection, and get an audio client.
cues.zh: 透過 Agent Factory 取得連線，再取得 AudioClient。

cues.en: For this we use ChatGPT 4.0 mini.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-4o mini 的語音轉錄模型。

cues.en: There is actually not really a newer one and they are perfectly okay as we just saw.
cues.zh: 目前沒有真正更新的版本，而且剛剛也看到，它已經相當好用。

cues.en: But with that audio client we just say transcript audio and we send our stream in and tell what file name we want it to be.
cues.zh: 接著透過 AudioClient 呼叫 TranscribeAudio，傳入串流，並提供檔案名稱。

cues.en: It gives a file name on the fly automatically.
cues.zh: 檔案名稱會在執行時自動產生。

cues.en: We don't set any special options or anything and we just want our transcribe back meaning what is the weather like in Paris and whatever we ask.
cues.zh: 沒有設定特殊選項，只需要取得轉錄結果，例如巴黎天氣如何，或其他說出的內容。

cues.en: And when we get that, if there's anything, we just add it to our input field which is our field down here.
cues.zh: 取得後，如果有文字，就加入下面的輸入欄位。

cues.en: So not much to it and finally of course tell that these two is now done.
cues.zh: 因此實作不多，最後當然也要把這兩個狀態設為完成。

cues.en: We also are using a dispose pattern on this because if we suddenly go away from our page
cues.zh: 另外也採用 Dispose 模式，因為如果錄音時，

cues.en: while we are recording, we need to cancel the recording and dispose the object.
cues.zh: 使用者離開頁面，需要取消錄音並釋放物件。

cues.en: And should we not be able to do that, that's okay.
cues.zh: 如果當時已無法完成清理，也允許處理這種情況。

cues.en: The final thing is the recording audio is just a little thing that gets a file name on the fly from the JS.
cues.zh: 最後，RecordingAudio 只是從 JavaScript 取得檔名與資料的小型結構。

cues.en: So there's actually not much to it, but again recording in most systems now is on OS level.
cues.zh: 所以沒有太多內容。現在多數系統也在作業系統層級提供語音輸入。

cues.en: It definitely is in iOS and on Android and on Mac it is as well.
cues.zh: iOS、Android，以及 Mac 都有。

cues.en: On Windows we don't really out of the box get something, but that's the only one that have this problem.
cues.zh: Windows 預設情況不太一樣，主要是它有這個差異。

cues.en: But most of the chatbots include such a feature, so we do as well.
cues.zh: 不過多數聊天機器人都有這種功能，因此我們也加入。

cues.en: But as you can see, not much code in order to do it.
cues.zh: 如你所見，不需要太多程式碼。

cues.en: So that's everything for this time.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
